facts.fact: The submission's photo caption says a substation on the boundary of the Burgundy suburbs feeds the Teraco complex in Cape Town (document published 2026-08-20, which is used as the date).

Teraco's 270-hectare, 120 MW Sediba solar facility near Parys in the Free State is described as built to power its data centres and as occupying agricultural land (document published 2026-08-20, which is used as the date).

The submission reports that Teraco's JB4 expansion, completed August 2025, is said to use a closed-loop system needing no ongoing water supply, and adds that such claims are not independently verified in South Africa and still need initial fill and make-up water.
